pokedexEntries.ru: EXPLOUD triggers earthquakes with the tremors it creates by bellowing. If this POKéMON violently inhales from the ports on its body, it’s a sign that it is preparing to let loose a huge bellow.

pokedexEntries.sa: EXPLOUD communicates its feelings to the others by emitting whistle-like sounds from the tubes on its body. This POKéMON only raises its voice when it is in battle.

pokedexEntries.frlg: It emits a variety of sounds from the holes all over its body. Its loud cries can be heard from over six miles away.

pokedexEntries.em: It has sound-generating organs all over its body. It communicates with others by adjusting the tone and volume of the cries it emits.

pokedexEntries.dpp: Its howls can be heard over six miles away. It emits all sorts of noises from the ports on its body.

pokedexEntries.hgss: Its roar in battle shakes the ground like a tremor--or like an earthquake has struck.

pokedexEntries.bw: Its howls can be heard over six miles away. It emits all sorts of noises from the ports on its body.

pokedexEntries.sw: In the past, people would use the loud voices of these Pokémon as a means of communication between distant cities.

pokedexEntries.sh: This Pokémon can do more than just shout. To communicate with others of its kind, it’ll emit all sorts of sounds from the holes in its body.
